title: From Lookups to Lessons: Turning Retrieved Knowledge into Parametric Memory
abstract: arXiv:2611.00450v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) helps large language models (LLMs) answer factual questions beyond their training data, but it adds storage and inference costs. Distilling previously retrieved information into parametric memories enables reuse without online retrieval. However, training the memory to mimic a retriever rewards accurate independent predictions, which do not necessarily improve the final output quality when combined with the LLM's existing predictions. To address this, we introduce ResMem, in which the LLM reads retrieved text offline to generate teacher targets. This design avoids storing massive token representations, unlike existing parametric memory approaches such as MLP Memory, which relies on k-nearest neighbor (kNN) datastores. translated_title: 从查找到学习：将检索到的知识转化为参数化记忆
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）能够帮助大语言模型（LLM）回答超出其训练数据范围的事实性问题，但会带来额外的存储和推理成本。将先前检索到的信息蒸馏到参数化记忆中，可以在无需在线检索的情况下实现知识复用。然而，训练记忆去模仿检索器只会奖励准确的独立预测，而这种预测在与LLM已有的预测相结合时，并不一定能提升最终输出的质量。为解决这一问题，我们提出了ResMem，让LLM在离线状态下阅读检索到的文本以生成教师目标。与依赖k近邻（kNN）数据存储的现有参数化记忆方法（如MLP Memory）不同，该设计避免了存储海量的token表示。此外，通过将LLM作为离线教师，让其在读取输入的同时获取特权的检索证据，我们训练参数化记忆学习一个加性的logit残差。
tldr: 提出ResMem方法，让LLM作为离线教师阅读检索文本生成教师目标，训练参数化记忆学习加性logit残差，从而在不存储海量token表示的前提下将检索知识有效转化为模型参数化记忆。
en_tdlr: ResMem employs the LLM as an offline teacher that reads retrieved text to generate teacher targets, training a parametric memory to learn an additive logit residual, thereby converting retrieved knowledge into parametric memory without storing massive token representations.
